note: Large full-service state park at Ashland, off I-80 between Omaha and Lincoln, with a lodge, cabins and a pool. Two campgrounds on the same park road about 400 m apart: Little Creek (sites 1-99) in mature woods, and Lakeside (sites 100-149, all full hookup) around a small pond, near Owen Marina Lake. Park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica confirms 148 paved RV sites in two loops (Little Creek 1-99: 48 E 30 A / 49 EP 50 A / 2 FH; Lakeside 100-149: 49 FH), 36-72 ft, open year round, showers/laundry/dump; phone (402)944-2523 matches. Fees re-based from RA quotes: $25 E / $30 EP (Apr 2027), FH $35 per grid -> 20-35, full_hookup surcharge cleared. Pin is ~610 m west of the campgrounds: re-pin. No split (loops ~400 m apart on one road). Not waterfront stands: the Lakeside pond is ~2.2 acres and RA tags every site 'Near Water - no'.
